units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:7">Sabb. II, 7</cite> <he>שלשה … צ׳ אדם לומר וכ׳</he> a man must order three things &c.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 110a:2">B. Bath. 110ᵃ</cite> <he>הנושא אשה צ׳ שיבדוק וכ׳</he> he who is about to marry a woman, should investigate the character of her brothers.
<cite ref="Berakhot 13a:22">Ber. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>צ׳ כונה</he> must be read with the intention to comply with the law.
<cite ref="Berakhot 14a:2">Ib. 14ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ואין צ׳ לומר</he> (abbrev. <he>ואצ״ל</he>, or <he>וא״צ לומר</he>) and needless to say, of course.
<cite ref="Yoma 83a:2">Yoma 83ᵃ</cite> <he>חולה אומר צ׳ … אינו צ׳</he> if the patient says that he needs food (cannot fast), and the physician says, he does not need.
<cite ref="Yoma 83a:10">Ib.</cite> <he>צ׳ אני</he> I must have food.
<cite ref="Tosefta Chagigah 2:11">Tosef. Ḥag. II, 11</cite> <he>צְרִיכֵנִי וכ׳</he> I must offer it &c.
<cite ref="Pesachim 5a:19">Pes. 5ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אינו צ׳</he> this reference to a Biblical verse is unnecessary.
Y. Ḥag. II, 78ᵃ top; Snh. 46ᵃ, a. e. השעה צ׳ לכך the condition of the time required such a measure; a. v. fr.—צדיכה (sub. שאלה, בדיקה &c.) is questionable, is undecided.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 4:1:2">Y. Ned. IV, beg. 38ᶜ</cite> <he>לקצור צ׳ ולבצור צ׳</he> (not <cite ref="R00775"><he>צריכא</he></cite>) as to harvesting and grape-cutting, it is questionable (whether he may borrow tools of one from whom he has vowed not to derive any benefit, v. <cite ref="E00678"><he>הֲנָאָה</he></cite>).—<he>צ׳ לנקביו</he>, v. <cite ref="N01157"><he>נֶקֶב</he></cite>, a. <cite ref="R00787"><he>צָרַךְ</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>צְרִיכִים</he>, <he>צְרִיכִין</he>; <he>צְרִיכוֹת</he>, <cite ref="Shabbat 55b:12">Sabb. 55ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>אנו צ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M00418"><he>מוֹדָעִי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 13a:22">Ber. 13ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מצות צ׳ כונה</he>, v. <cite ref="K00303"><he>כַּוָּנָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Ketubot 21b:5">Keth. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>אינן צ׳ להעד וכ׳</he> need not testify before court (to the identity of their signature); a. v. fr.—[<he>צְרִיכֵי</he>, <cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 4:7">Shek. IV, 7</cite> Y. ed., v. <cite ref="R00255"><he>צוֹרֶךְ</he></cite>.]
